description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller with endpoints for greeting, API documentation, health checks, and application info. It uses annotations for Swagger/OpenAPI documentation and handles HTTP requests for different routes.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic endpoints like greeting, documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message when the root URL is accessed.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to Swagger UI, preserving the original request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns the application health status as 'OK'.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns application information including its name.
